prompt: Cinematic film still. In the center of a snow-covered town square, an old stone fountain stands frozen with icicles hanging from its rim. To the left of the fountain, a woman in a blue coat holds a steaming cup of coffee while looking at a child in a yellow hat who is pointing at a pigeon pecking at crumbs on the ground. Next to the child, a brown dog sits patiently on a wooden bench, watching a man in a red scarf who is handing a glove to a girl in pink boots. The girl in pink boots stands next to the man in the red scarf, smiling as she accepts the item. Behind them, a streetlamp glows softly against the twilight sky, casting long shadows across the white pavement. To the right of the fountain, a vendor in a green apron arranges oranges in a wooden crate, while a customer in a grey beanie reaches out to select one. A black cat perches on top of the crate, observing the transaction with keen interest. Nearby, a cyclist in a neon jacket leans their bicycle against a lamppost, adjusting their helmet. Two teenagers in hoodies walk past the cyclist, laughing as they kick snowballs at each other. A police officer in a dark uniform stands near the edge of the square, talking to an elderly man with a cane who is leaning on a park bench. A stray goose wanders near the officer’s feet, honking softly. In the background, a bus with lit windows waits at the curb, its doors open. A driver in a cap looks out from the bus window, checking his watch. A suitcase rests on the snow beside the bus steps, abandoned for a moment. A newspaper flutters near the suitcase, caught in a gentle breeze. There is no sun visible in the sky. There is no traffic moving on the roads. There is no digital signage or screens present.
